build.linker: Modwerk engine (scripts/link-image.mjs) from this module's build.json and the author's own OS 1.54 file

capture.sandbox: none: a Linux VM with no macOS sandbox-exec; the script ran with the emulator only
capture.frameSelection: Most populated actual LCD frame within the final 250 ms after the latest panel action; 6x integer scaling.

setup: Disposable first-boot project made by the script; only panel input from capture-plan.txt. No RAM, menu or parameter state written. The emulator's knobs lag behind real time, so the plan waits after each turn.
